messages:
elena.m (pm): Morning — putting Dawnlight (private) switchover on the calendar for Fri 02:00 UTC. Need final ops + SRE ack, KMS check, and explicit version pin. TL;DR: scheduled maintenance window 02:00–03:00 UTC.

samir (eng): Ack from infra. Canary runs green on staging, perf looks stable. We should pin model to v2.3.1-rc2 (quantized-8bit) for the cutover to keep latency low.

luca (sre): Quick checklist: 1) KMS rotation collision? 2) capacity reserve for dedicated pool (+20%) 3) rollback playbook ready. I want to set latency SLA guard at 120ms p50 and 300ms p95 during canary.

jordan (release): @elena.m we need release notes snippet for customers. Also confirm whether we allow graceful fallback to hosted variant if private nodes fail.

elena.m (pm): Release notes will call out: pinned model v2.3.1-rc2, small quantization change, expected 15% cost improvement. Yes to fallback — prefer failover to hosted read-only policy not to serve mismatched weights.

ops-oncall: Heads up — KMS rotation is scheduled same day at 01:30 UTC for another tenant. That might conflict. Can we ask security to delay or we move the window earlier? @luca can you confirm KMS dependency?

luca (sre): KMS used only for operator keys during bootstrap. If rotation hits while we reprovision nodes we could block decrypting the initial bundle. Recommend moving our switchover to 03:30 UTC or ask security to pause their rotation for 90m.

samir (eng): Moving to 03:30 would impact client maintenance windows (they requested late-night). Alternative: we do a staged boot without full rebootstrap — use existing cached keys and gate final swap until post-rotation. That needs extra validation.

deploy-bot: preflight checks running...

deploy-bot: preflight results: canary tests: PASS (10/10), perf baseline diff: +1.8% p95, KV cache warm hit 92%, rollout candidate: v2.3.1-rc2-quant8.

jordan (release): Based on preflight, I'm good with pinned version. Need explicit rollback threshold: if p95 > 400ms or error rate > 0.8% for 10m during canary, we roll back.

luca (sre): Agreed. Add an auto-rollback hook in deploy config: 
```
rollback_on:
  - metric: http_error_rate
    threshold: 0.008
    window: 600
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    threshold: 400
    window: 600
```
Make sure deploy-bot has permission to trigger the rollback.

samir (eng): We'll also stage a fallback model alias that points to hosted v2.3.0-legacy if rollback fires. No data plane changes required.

elena.m (pm): Final asks before I lock the window: ops-oncall confirm KMS pause or we shift; luca confirm rollback hook added; samir confirm fallback alias staged; jordan confirm release notes ready.

ops-oncall: I've opened incident-XXXX to request a short KMS hold. Security responded: can delay by 2 hours. They asked for customer signoff — elena, can you confirm?

elena.m (pm): I can confirm — we approve the 2h delay. Locking switchover for Fri 03:30–04:30 UTC.

luca (sre): Rollback hooks added to deploy config and verified in dry-run. Deploy-bot has iam:TriggerRollback permission.

samir (eng): Fallback alias staged and smoke-tested. No extra DB migrations.

jordan (release): Release notes ready, sent to customer success for pre-notify.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout queued for 1759997000 (2025-??-?? 03:30 UTC). Will post updates during the window. :rocket:

elena.m (pm): Thanks team — locking window and marking go for Friday. I'll post the customer advisory and update the runbook. :white_check_mark:
